k:沈.mnemonic: A swimmer goes limp (尢) and floats on his back. The tsunami (氵) wave rolls over his forehead (冖) and he slips down out of sight under the water. Be submerged (sink, subside, be depressed).
k:沈.hint: Wave rolling over a limp swimmer.

k:誘.mnemonic: Say (言) to someone 'you excel (秀) at this, nobody does it better' and they will follow you anywhere you like. Entice (lead, tempt, invite).

k:坊.mnemonic: Let him out and he runs in every direction (方) at once, then comes home covered in soil (土) from head to foot. Boy (priest's residence, priest).

k:訓.mnemonic: What the teacher says (言) flows on like a river (川), and the pupils are carried along with it from one lesson to the next. Instruction (explanation, read, reading).
k:訓.hint: Teacher's words flowing like a river.

k:驚.mnemonic: A horse (馬) on its daily trudge (夂) turns a corner and finds a whole crowd bowing to it in respect (敬). It rears up, eyes wide. Wonder (be surprised, frightened, amazed).
k:驚.hint: Horse rearing at a bowing crowd.

k:雇.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) knocks at your door (戸) looking for work. You hand it an apron and agree a wage. Employ (hire, use, utilize).
k:雇.hint: Turkey at the door wants work.

k:融.mnemonic: An insect (虫) made of sugar, facing (向) a steaming cauldron (鬲), leans in too close, drops into the soup and is gone without a trace. Dissolve (melt).

k:剣.mnemonic: A person (人) in a pointed hat (𠆢) wears at his side a knife (刂) so long it reaches from the ground to his mouth (口). Too long for a knife: it is a duelling blade. Sabre (sword, blade, clock hand).
k:剣.hint: A knife as long as a man.

k:患.mnemonic: A skewer through the middle (中) of the heart (心): a pain lodged right at your centre that will not go away. Afflicted (disease, suffer from, be ill).

k:袋.mnemonic: A traveller is reliant (依) on it: the cloth bundle hanging from a peg (弋) by the door, holding everything he owns. Sack (bag, pouch).

k:炎.mnemonic: Fire (火) stacked on fire: one flame leaping up on top of another until the whole thing roars. Blaze (flame, inflammation, fire).

k:髪.mnemonic: A mane (髟) grown so long that it drags on the ground behind you as you trudge (夂) along. Time for a cut. Hair (hair of the head).

k:努.mnemonic: The guy (奴) who puts all his power (力) into the job, day after day, and never takes a shortcut. Toil (diligent, as much as possible).
k:努.hint: The guy who gives full strength.

k:眠.mnemonic: When the eye (目) of every one of the people (民) is shut, the whole town lies quiet until morning. Sleep (sleepy).
k:眠.hint: A whole town with eyes shut.

k:核.mnemonic: Cut open the fruit of the tree (木) and at the very centre sits the stone, curled up like a tiny person (人) asleep. Nucleus (core, kernel).

k:漁.mnemonic: Boats ride out on water still heaving from the tsunami (氵) and haul up nets full of fish (魚). Fishing (fishery).

k:猛.mnemonic: A hound (犭) guards the dinner dish (皿) of the child (子). Come one step nearer and it bares every tooth. Fierce (rave, rush, wildness).

k:藩.mnemonic: The lord's land is ringed by a hedge of flowers (艹) and a moat deep enough to stop a tsunami (氵), and guards take turn (番) after turn at the gate. Enclosure (clan).
k:藩.hint: Hedge, moat and guards in rotation.

k:没.mnemonic: Throw a heavy weapon (殳) into the water left by the tsunami (氵) and it goes straight to the bottom. Sink (drown, hide, fall into).

k:俊.mnemonic: While the others trudge (夂) on tired legs (儿), the leader (亻) stops to study a cocoon (厶) and works out how to spin silk from it. A mind that sees further. Sagacious (genius, excellence).

k:看.mnemonic: A hand (手) shading the eye (目), kept there for three (三) nights in a row beside the sickbed. Watch over (see, look, watch).
k:看.hint: Hand over eye by the sickbed.

k:誠.mnemonic: Whatever you say (言) will become (成) what you do. Your words turn into deeds, every time. Sincerity (truth, admonish, warn).

k:維.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) tied by the leg with thread (糸). It pulls and pulls, but the twisted strands hold. Fiber (tie, rope).

k:嫌.mnemonic: A woman (女) chases an unwelcome visitor out of the house with a broom (ヨ). Her feelings about him could not be clearer. Dislike (detest, hate).

k:梨.mnemonic: The tree (木) that turns a profit (利): every autumn its heavy, juicy golden fruit sells out at the market. Pear tree.
k:梨.hint: The tree whose fruit sells out.

k:択.mnemonic: A row of little flags on the table. Your fingers (扌) hover over them, then pick up one flag (尸). Select (choose, elect, prefer).

k:訃.mnemonic: The divining rod (卜) foretold it, and now someone must say (言) it aloud to the town: the notice that a person has died. Obituary.

k:還.mnemonic: The garment (衣) that arrived does not fit. You put it in a net (罒) bag, tell the courier by word of mouth (口) where it came from, and off it goes down the same path (辶). Send back (return).
